skill.name: organizing-with-labels
skill.description: Helps users design GitHub label taxonomies, apply labels in bulk, manage milestones, and review issue organization with optional helper scripts.
skill.summary: Organize GitHub issues with structured labels, milestones, and progress reports.
skill.author: C0ntr0lledCha0s

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, documentation examples, or GitHub CLI subprocess calls that use argv lists. No prompt injection, secret access, or arbitrary shell execution was found in the cited files. A medium contextual risk remains because helper scripts can make bulk GitHub repository changes and should require dry-run review and explicit confirmation.

remediation.issue: Bulk operations can modify many GitHub issues, labels, or milestones.
remediation.suggestion: Require dry-run output and explicit user confirmation before bulk apply, cleanup, rename, delete, or milestone assignment actions.

remediation.issue: Destructive label cleanup can remove repository labels.
remediation.suggestion: Export the current label set before cleanup and provide rollback guidance for renamed or deleted labels.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts depend on external gh CLI execution.
remediation.suggestion: Document required GitHub permissions and keep subprocess calls shell-free with fixed command arrays.

static_findings.snippet: error(f"Invalid date format: {date_str}. Use YYYY-MM-DD, days from now (e.g., 14), or MM/DD/YYYY")
- Label already exists → Use `--force` to update
- Milestone date invalid → Use ISO 8601 format
- Permission denied → Need repository write access

semantic_findings.title: Bulk GitHub Repository Mutations Require Confirmation
semantic_findings.description: The helper scripts can apply labels or milestones across many issues and can rename or delete labels. This matches the skill purpose, but marketplace users need dry-run output and explicit approval before mutations.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited functions directly edit GitHub issues or labels in loops after normal execution paths. The risk is unintended repository state changes, not command injection or data theft.

medium_findings.title: Bulk GitHub Repository Mutations Require Confirmation
medium_findings.description: The helper scripts can apply labels or milestones across many issues and can rename or delete labels. This matches the skill purpose, but marketplace users need dry-run output and explicit approval before mutations.

content.value_statement: Large repositories lose time when issues use inconsistent labels and unclear milestones. This skill helps create taxonomies, run bulk updates, and report progress through GitHub workflows.
actual_capabilities: Designs label groups for type, priority, scope, status, and size.
Explains GitHub label colors, naming conventions, and cleanup patterns.
Provides helper workflows for creating, editing, deleting, and exporting labels.
Supports milestone creation, assignment, progress tracking, and reporting.
Can infer useful labels from issue titles and bodies through the included script.
Can generate label usage and consistency reports for repository cleanup.
limitations: Requires the GitHub CLI and repository permissions for live changes.
Bulk operations can change many issues, labels, or milestones if approved.
Label inference is keyword based and may need human review.
The helper scripts target GitHub repositories, not other issue trackers.

use_cases.title: Standardize a repository taxonomy
use_cases.description: Create consistent type, priority, scope, status, and size labels for a growing project.

use_cases.title: Plan a sprint or release
use_cases.description: Create milestones, assign matching issues, and track progress by open and closed work.

use_cases.title: Clean up issue triage
use_cases.description: Find missing labels, unused labels, and inconsistent naming before a maintenance pass.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic taxonomy
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a standard label taxonomy for this repository. Explain each label group before making any changes.

prompt_templates.title: Review existing labels
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current GitHub labels. Identify missing groups, unused labels, and inconsistent names. Return a cleanup plan.

prompt_templates.title: Bulk label matching issues
prompt_templates.prompt: Bulk apply labels to open issues matching this search: <search query>. Start with a dry run and show planned changes.

prompt_templates.title: Manage release milestones
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a release milestone, assign matching issues, and report progress by label. Ask for confirmation before repository changes.

output_examples.input: Organize labels for a new API project.
output_examples.output: A standard taxonomy with bug, feature, documentation, priority, backend scope, and needs-triage labels.
A milestone report with due date, completion percentage, open issues, closed issues, and label-based progress.
A review of unused labels, missing priority labels, naming inconsistencies, and recommended safe cleanup steps.

best_practices: Run dry-run mode before bulk apply, cleanup, or milestone assignment.
Use clear prefixes such as type, priority, scope, status, and size.
Export current labels before renaming or deleting repository labels.
anti_patterns: Deleting or renaming labels without checking issue impact.
Mixing type, priority, and status meanings in one label name.
Running bulk operations before confirming the target issue list.

faq.question: Does this skill require GitHub access?
faq.answer: Live repository changes require the GitHub CLI and write permission. Planning and taxonomy design do not require access.

faq.question: Can it work without running scripts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can provide label plans, milestone structures, and review guidance without executing helper scripts.

faq.question: What label groups does it support?
faq.answer: It supports type, priority, scope, status, size, and custom groups that match repository needs.

faq.question: Can it update many issues at once?
faq.answer: Yes. The helper scripts include bulk apply and milestone assignment workflows, so confirm dry-run output first.

faq.question: Does it create milestones?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide milestone creation, update due dates, assign issues, close milestones, and report progress.

faq.question: Can it migrate old labels?
faq.answer: Yes. It can map old labels to a new taxonomy and suggest a staged migration plan.
